_README: Tools manifest. Each item appears as a card on /tools.html. Add/remove entries here. Categories are filterable on the page (dev, design, productivity, ai, files, learning).
_HOW_TO_ADD: 1) Add a new entry to items[] below.
2) Required: title, category, description, url. Optional: tags[], free (true/false), notes.
4) Categories supported by the filter chips: dev | design | productivity | ai | files | learning. Pick the closest fit; use 'productivity' as a catch-all.

items.title: ChatGPT
items.description: Conversational AI assistant for writing, coding help, research, brainstorming, and quick explanations.

items.title: Claude
items.description: Anthropic's AI assistant — strong at long-form writing, document analysis, and thoughtful coding help.

items.title: GitHub
items.description: Code hosting, version control, and collaboration. Free for public and private repositories.

items.title: VS Code
items.description: Free, fast, extensible code editor. Great for everything from quick edits to full projects.

items.title: Stack Overflow
items.description: When something breaks, someone has probably already asked about it. Search before you ask.

items.title: MDN Web Docs
items.description: The reference I trust for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web APIs. Clear examples, accurate detail.

items.title: CodePen
items.description: Quick online sandbox for HTML/CSS/JS prototypes and UI experiments.

items.title: Figma
items.description: Collaborative design tool for UI, prototypes, and design systems. Free tier covers most solo work.

items.title: Canva
items.description: Beginner-friendly graphic design for posters, social posts, presentations, and quick branding mockups.

items.title: Coolors
items.description: Generate color palettes in seconds. Press space to lock the colors you like and reroll the rest.

items.title: Unsplash
items.description: Free, high-quality stock photos for projects, mockups, and websites. No attribution required.

items.title: Notion
items.description: Notes, tasks, docs, and lightweight databases in one workspace. Great for personal knowledge bases.

items.title: Trello
items.description: Simple Kanban boards for organizing personal projects, freelance work, or team tasks.

items.title: Google Drive
items.description: Cloud storage with Docs, Sheets, and Slides built in. 15 GB free — enough for most personal use.

items.title: WeTransfer
items.description: Send big files (up to 2 GB) to anyone with a link. No account needed.

items.title: iLovePDF
items.description: Merge, split, compress, convert, and edit PDFs in your browser. Most operations are free.

items.title: TinyPNG
items.description: Compress PNG and JPG images without visible quality loss. Big speed wins for websites.

items.title: freeCodeCamp
items.description: Free, project-based courses from HTML/CSS basics through full-stack development and data analysis.

items.title: The Odin Project
items.description: Free, opinionated full-stack curriculum that emphasizes building real projects from day one.

items.title: YouTube
items.description: Endless free tutorials on basically every topic. Quality varies — pick channels with good reputations.
